scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:ui && npm run bundle:host && node scripts/copy-nodejs-into-dist.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleFullDebug && node ../scripts/copy-apk.mjs debug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/ensure-keystore-props.mjs && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleFullRelease && node ../scripts/copy-apk.mjs release
